description:
n this video, we put two of the most powerful next-generation gaming handhelds head-to-head: the all-new ROG Xbox Ally X20 powered by the AMD Ryzen AI Z2 Extreme and the MSI Claw 8 EX AI+ powered by the Intel Arc G3 Extreme! We test both handhelds side-by-side at 35W, 25W, and 17W TDP across synthetic benchmarks and AAA games—including Cyberpunk 2077, Forza Horizon 6, and Red Dead Redemption 2—with matched resolution scaling (XeSS Balanced vs FSR Performance) and native 1080p to see which chip comes out on top. We also break down battery life and the massive price jump on both devices.
